# Support

1. **Read the docs first.** The [README](../README.md) covers install, how it works and known limits.
2. **Search issues.** Your question may already be answered in [Issues](../../issues).
3. **Ask or report.** Open a new issue with the steps to reproduce, your OS, herdr version and browser.
